note: 坐标为近似位置，仅用于研学导览示意；同一校区内的点位按方位做了小幅偏移，避免地标重叠。

school.name: 湖南省立第一师范学校旧址
school.name_en: Site of Hunan First Normal School
school.addr: 长沙市天心区书院路 356 号
school.intro: 一师核心校区，前身是南宋城南书院。毛泽东在此求学、执教共八年，校训「实事求是」影响了他的一生。
school.intro_en: The core campus of Hunan First Normal School, whose predecessor was Chengnan Academy of the Southern Song. Mao studied and taught here for eight years; the motto 'seeking truth from facts' shaped his life.

class8.name: 第八班教室
class8.addr: 第一师范旧址教学楼二层（第八班教室）
class8.addr_en: Second floor, teaching building of the school site
class8.intro: 毛泽东在一师求学时的固定教室，第一行第四座是他的座位。
class8.intro_en: Mao's fixed classroom; the fourth seat in the first row was his.

well.name: 一师水井
well.addr: 第一师范旧址院内水井
well.addr_en: In the courtyard of the school site
well.intro: 毛泽东常年在此进行冷水浴，四季不断，是他「野蛮其体魄」的具体实践。
well.intro_en: Mao took cold-water baths here all year round — a concrete practice of 'toughening the body'.

pavilion.name: 君子亭
pavilion.addr_en: On the campus of the school site
pavilion.intro: 毛泽东常在此读书，并与同学探讨国家大事。
pavilion.intro_en: Mao often read here and discussed national affairs with classmates.

hall.name: 大礼堂
hall.addr_en: On the campus of the school site
hall.intro: 校内举行集会、演讲及学术活动的重要场所。
hall.intro_en: An important venue for assemblies, speeches and academic activities.

readingroom.name: 阅报室
readingroom.addr_en: On the campus of the school site
readingroom.intro: 毛泽东在一师期间每天必去的地方，在此读报、关心天下时政。
readingroom.intro_en: Where Mao went every day to read newspapers and follow current affairs.

chengnan.name: 城南书院
chengnan.addr: 长沙市天心区（第一师范旧址内）
chengnan.addr_en: Tianxin District, Changsha (within the school site)
chengnan.intro: 一师前身，南宋始建，体现「千年学府、百年师范」的湖湘文脉。
chengnan.intro_en: The school's predecessor, founded in the Southern Song, embodying a thousand-year academy and a century-old normal school.

xinmin.name: 新民学会成立会旧址
xinmin.name_en: Site of the Founding of the New People's Study Society
xinmin.addr: 长沙市岳麓区溁湾镇刘家台子（蔡和森故居）
xinmin.addr_en: Liujiataizi, Yingwan Town, Yuelu District, Changsha
xinmin.intro: 1918 年 4 月，毛泽东、蔡和森、萧子升等在此发起成立新民学会，萧子升任首任总干事，何叔衡是最年长的会员。
xinmin.intro_en: In April 1918 Mao, Cai Hesen and Xiao Zisheng founded the New People's Study Society here; Xiao was its first secretary-general and He Shuheng its oldest member.

routes.title: 半天经典线
routes.summary: 只走校本部，把「教室 — 水井 — 阅报室」串起来，看懂毛泽东在一师的日常。
routes.summary_en: Stay on campus and link the classroom, the well and the reading room to see Mao's daily life at the school.
tasks: 在第八班教室找到毛泽东的座位（第一行第四座），拍一张照片。
在水井边说出「文明其精神，野蛮其体魄」的出处。
在阅报室记录一条 1919 年前后的时政新闻标题。
tasks_en: Find Mao's seat in the Class Eight classroom (fourth seat, first row) and take a photo.
Stand by the well and explain where 'civilise the spirit, toughen the body' comes from.
Write down one news headline from around 1919 at the reading room.

routes.title: 一日深度线
routes.summary: 校本部全部点位 + 城南书院，从建筑格局读到湖湘文脉。
routes.summary_en: All campus points plus Chengnan Academy, reading Huxiang culture from the buildings themselves.
tasks: 按建造年代给城南书院、大礼堂、第八班教室排序。
说出君子亭为什么适合「读书 + 议政」这两件事。
在校内找到「实事求是」相关的题刻或陈列。
tasks_en: Order Chengnan Academy, the assembly hall and the Class Eight classroom by age.
Explain why the Junzi Pavilion suited both reading and discussing state affairs.
Find an inscription or display related to 'seeking truth from facts' on campus.

routes.title: 精神传承线
routes.summary: 从校训到新民学会：看一师如何把「求学」变成「救国」。
routes.summary_en: From the school motto to the New People's Study Society: how study became a way of saving the nation.
tasks: 在旧址找到校训「实事求是」的出处说明。
对比「读有字之书」和「读无字之书」各指什么。
在新民学会旧址说出首任总干事与最年长会员分别是谁。
tasks_en: Find where the motto 'seeking truth from facts' comes from.
Compare 'reading books with words' and 'reading the book without words'.
At the Xinmin site, name its first secretary-general and its oldest member.
